Versioned clinical formulas expanded into private numeric declarations

Source: R/formulas.R
omop_formula_bmi.Rd

Versioned clinical formulas expanded into private numeric declarations

Usage

omop_formula_bmi(weight, height, version = "1.0.0")

omop_formula_map(systolic, diastolic, version = "1.0.0")

omop_formula_ratio(numerator, denominator, unit, version = "1.0.0")

omop_formula_egfr_ckdepi2021(creatinine, age, sex, sex_map, version = "1.0.0")

Arguments

weight, height

Typed numeric variables in coordinate:kg and coordinate:metres.

version

Installed exact definition version, currently 1.0.0.

systolic, diastolic

Typed numeric variables in coordinate:mmHg.

numerator, denominator

Aligned numeric declarations with resolved units.

unit

Declared result coordinate for a ratio.

creatinine

Typed selected creatinine in coordinate:idms_creatinine_mg_dl.

age

Completed calendar years from omop_age_at at the creatinine anchor.

sex

Admitted categorical variable whose source is justified by the study.

sex_map

Named list female and male, each a nonempty vector of disjoint stable category identities; no missing, unknown or wildcard identities.

Value

An ordinary numeric variable expanded into closed primitives, with immutable client formula provenance. No patient computation occurs here.

Details

Declare named physical coordinates with an explicit omop_number_unit conversion from the source unit; for example micromol/L to IDMS creatinine mg/dL divides by 88.4. No unit, source concept, sex interpretation or anchor is guessed. All bindings use stage=presented so conversions and log/exp transforms survive. Independently selected measurements do not imply contemporaneity. Invalid inputs become private typed NA; unavailable sources retain unavailability. Age requires completed calendar years, not annual_years or baseline age at an unrelated visit. Use a first/last/nth measurement selector with missing=keep and a matching start-date anchor, or a day-zero selector and age at index. Put source-unit normalization on the shared event used by both creatinine and its age anchor. An input-local source map must match that shared map; keep explicit numeric coordinate conversions on the creatinine input. Sex mapping is an explicit public protocol assertion, not an interpretation of a field named gender. CKD-EPI 2021 uses no race operand and is an adult estimate.
